items.title_en: AI in Satellite Networks: Challenges and Solutions for LEO Constellations
summary_en: The growth of orbital data and need for real-time services are forcing LEO satellites to use AI processing instead of simple relays. However, AI training needs lots of computing power, memory, and stable connections, which are hard to get in satellite networks with limited resources.
Researchers are rethinking AI workflows to address these challenges, focusing on distributed training and collaborative inference methods suitable for LEO constellations.
key_points_en: Satellite networks face severe resource limitations for AI tasks
AI workflows must be redesigned for dynamic satellite environments
LEO constellations require new approaches to training and inference
translation_zh: 轨道数据的增长和对实时服务的需求迫使低地球轨道卫星使用人工智能处理，而不是简单的中继。然而，人工智能训练需要大量的计算能力、内存和稳定的连接，这在资源有限的卫星网络中难以实现。
研究人员正在重新设计人工智能工作流程，以解决这些挑战，重点是适合低地球轨道星座的分布式训练和协作推理方法。

items.title_en: Building Modern Diffusion Language Models: A New Approach
summary_en: Large language models (LLMs) have improved quickly by using scaling laws for training on big text collections.
However, they generate text one token at a time, which slows down processing and wastes GPU power.
Diffusion models solve these problems by allowing parallel computation and correcting errors
key_points_en: LLMs generate text sequentially, slowing performance
Parallel GPUs are underused during inference
Diffusion models enable error correction and parallel processing
translation_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）通过使用扩展定律在大量文本集合上训练，进步迅速。
然而，它们逐个生成文本标记，导致处理速度变慢且浪费GPU资源。
扩散模型通过并行计算和错误修正解决了这些问题。

vocab.zh: 扩展定律（指模型训练中性能与参数规模的关系）
自回归生成（逐个生成文本标记的过程）
并行GPU硬件（可同时处理多个计算任务的硬件）
推理阶段计算（模型生成输出时的计算过程）
离散扩散模型（改进传统生成方式的新模型类型）

items.title_en: Fast Decision-Making with System 1 Models: A New Approach Beyond LLMs
summary_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are good at reasoning but too slow for quick decisions needed by AI systems. System 1 models solve this by making decisions in one step instead of token-by-token.
This guide explains how System 1 models work and categorizes them into five types for practical use in AI development.
key_points_en: LLMs are slow for routine decisions
System 1 models use single-pass processing
Five-family taxonomy classifies decision models
translation_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）擅长推理，但处理AI系统需要的快速决策时太慢。System 1模型通过一步到位的决策解决这个问题。
这份指南解释了System 1模型的工作原理，并将其分为五类，便于AI开发中的实际应用。

items.title_en: Apple releases iOS 27.2 update with new Siri features and security improvements
summary_en: Apple has released iOS 27.2, adding new Siri AI language support and important security updates.
The update improves device security and expands Siri's ability to understand different languages
key_points_en: Adds support for new languages in Siri's AI capabilities
Includes important security updates to protect devices
Available for iPhones and iPads running iOS 27.2
translation_zh: Apple 已发布 iOS 27.2，新增 Siri 人工智能语言支持并包含重要的安全更新
该更新提升了设备安全性，并扩展了 Siri 理解不同语言的能力

items.title_en: JetBlue's Stock Rises as Cost-Cutting Plan Eases Investor Concerns
summary_en: JetBlue Airways is implementing a cost-cutting strategy to boost premium revenue, which has led to a rise in its stock price as investors grow more confident in the company's future.
The airline's plan to reduce expenses while focusing on higher-paying services has reassured market participants about its financial direction.
key_points_en: JetBlue is cutting costs to improve profitability
Premium revenue growth is a key focus of the strategy
Stock prices have increased due to improved investor sentiment
translation_zh: 捷蓝航空正在实施一项削减成本的策略，以增加高利润收入，这使得投资者对公司未来的信心增强，股价随之上涨。
该航空公司通过减少开支并专注于高收入服务，使市场参与者对其财务前景更加放心。

items.title_en: Coca-Cola Raises Earnings Forecast Despite Weak North American Demand
summary_en: Coca-Cola has increased its earnings forecast for the year, despite weak consumer demand in North America. The company's stock has risen about 32% this year, boosting its market value to approximately $398 billion.
key_points_en: Earnings outlook raised for 2023
Stock price up 32% year-to-date
Market capitalization reaches $398 billion
translation_zh: 可口可乐公司提高了今年的盈利预期，尽管北美地区消费者需求疲软。该公司今年股价上涨了约32%，使其市值达到约3980亿美元。

items.title_en: Apple Launches 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 Chip and Enhanced Features
summary_en: The new 14-inch MacBook Pro has 24 hours of battery life and supports Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity.
Apple is improving performance and connectivity with the latest chip and wireless technologies.
key_points_en: 24-hour battery life
Wi-Fi 7 support
Bluetooth 6 support
translation_zh: 苹果推出搭载M6芯片的14英寸MacBook Pro，电池续航达24小时，并支持最新的Wi-Fi 7和蓝牙6技术。
苹果通过最新芯片和无线技术提升性能和连接性。

items.title_en: U.S. Consumer Spending Remains Strong Despite High Inflation
summary_en: Companies like Royal Caribbean, Coca-Cola, and UPS report steady consumer spending in early third-quarter earnings.
This suggests resilience in the U.S. economy even with high inflation pressures.
key_points_en: Major companies report stable spending
High inflation continues
Third-quarter earnings show resilience
translation_zh: 皇家加勒比、可口可乐和UPS等公司报告早前第三季度的稳定消费支出
这表明即使面临高通胀压力，美国经济仍表现出韧性

vocab.zh: 具有韧性的美国消费者
